'''Falleen''' was the native language of the [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]]. It had both a written and spoken form. Falleens leaving their home planet learned to speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] as well.<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology" />
